Definition: Is artificial intelligence integrated into the data exchange for data quality, fraud detection or predictive analytics
Comments: No evidence found of AI/analytics integrated into Uganda's UgHub data exchange platform or broader e-government data exchange operations. Digital Uganda Vision and e-GIF documentation do not reference AI deployment in data exchange.
redteam_note: No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Original two cited PDFs (NITA-U Digital Government Strategy, e-GIF) fetched and read: neither references AI/ML in the UgHub data exchange platform. Cross-checked against the current NITA-U UgHub service page and a 2024 DIAL case study on Uganda's data exchange: UgHub is described as offering 'reporting and analytics' capability and an IoT-ready architecture, but no source states AI, machine learning, or predictive-analytics techniques are actually deployed for data quality, fraud detection, or eligibility prediction within the exchange itself (a separate Social Protection Single Registry describes rule-based fraud-prevention and analytics services, but this is not confirmed as AI and sits outside the core data exchange platform). Score of 0 (Unknown/no evidence) confirmed.
revised_comments: No evidence is available that artificial intelligence is integrated into Uganda's data exchange (UgHub) for data quality, fraud detection, or predictive analytics. NITA-U's Digital Government Strategy and e-Government Interoperability Framework (e-GIF) documents make no reference to AI deployment. The UgHub platform is publicly described as offering reporting and analytics capabilities and IoT-readiness, but no authoritative source confirms AI/ML techniques are in active use within the exchange for these purposes.

Definition: Level of public transparency regarding data exchange operations, governance, and data sharing agreements
Comments: NITA-U publishes e-GIF, Digital Strategy, and annual reports publicly. Government Enterprise Architecture documentation public. Moderate transparency through official NITA-U website publications. No real-time public data exchange dashboard identified.
redteam_note: Value Name differs from the scale label — usually cosmetic.
revision_notes: The original comment stated 'No real-time public data exchange dashboard identified,' but a live public dashboard does exist: the Ministry of ICT and National Guidance operates the 'ICT Smart Monitor' dashboard (digital.ict.go.ug/dashboard), which publicly reports the number of entities onboarded onto UGHub (government and private, by year) alongside other ICT sector indicators, updated on an ongoing basis. In addition, NITA-U's annual Statistical Abstract (2023 edition fetched and read) contains a dedicated section (Fig. 27) presenting multi-year statistics on the 'Data Sharing and Integration Platform.' Together, a public dashboard plus annual statistical reporting matches the scale's top category (4 = High = Public Dashboard & Reports) rather than 'Moderate = Annual Reports' alone. Value code raised from 3 to 4 on this basis.
revised_comments: Uganda demonstrates a high level of public transparency regarding its data exchange operations. The Ministry of ICT and National Guidance publishes a live public dashboard (ICT Smart Monitor) reporting the number of government and private entities onboarded onto the UGHub data exchange platform, alongside other national ICT indicators. This is complemented by NITA-U's annual Statistical Abstract, which includes a dedicated multi-year section on the Data Sharing and Integration Platform, and by publicly available Digital Government Strategy and e-Government Interoperability Framework documents.
